reviews.text: James did some welding work on my home's sliding gate in Frisco earlier this year (2025). It was a top notch experience from start to finish. The welding has held up nicely so far. He cared about the overall work and also spray painted the welded joints to extend their lifespan. I am writing this review to save his details in my list so that I can reach out to him for future projects. I highly recommend him
reviews.author: Sourabh Bansal

reviews.text: James does top quality work. No BS. Got 500 ft of 8ft cedar, steel posts. Custom gates, steel frame - no sagging.
reviews.author: Brian Prescott

reviews.text: Fantastic work and service. On time and great quality of workmanship. Give James a call and get your new fence!
reviews.author: A C

reviews.text: Our daughter accidentally hit the gas instead of the break and it took out about a 8’ fence section. They were super professional from the very beginning. They provided excellent materials and labor at a very reasonable cost.  They were quick and very kind. I highly recommend this local company!
reviews.author: Jenni Devenny

reviews.text: Great work by James at Prosper Fence & Welding! They repaired several areas on our wrought iron fence. It was done well and at a reasonable price. Very happy to recommend them to others!
reviews.author: Christine S

reviews.text: James and his guys did an awesome job replacing a section of my fence. Very reasonable prices and top quality work!
reviews.author: Lynn Martin

reviews.text: Experienced fence company and excellent certified welder!
reviews.author: Paul Wood

reviews.text: Knows what he's doing. Amazing work.
